jobs.sourceName: Fidelity Investments / FMR India – Naukri requisition 130225010415 (Naukri exact page restricted to automated checks)
jobs.desc: Fidelity Investments (FMR India) is recruiting Apprentice – Engineering Graduates for Bengaluru and Chennai. The current Naukri-linked listing targets 2025 and 2026 B.E./B.Tech graduates with no previous work experience, for an engineering apprenticeship involving software-development activities on Agile teams. The Naukri salary listing is reported as ₹5.5 LPA, and 40 positions are reported. Program duration, work mode, stipend-vs-CTC terms and conversion to a permanent role are not specified in the accessible listing; please verify these with Fidelity before accepting any offer.
jobs.elig: B.E. / B.Tech, 2025 or 2026 pass-outs, in a stated engineering branch: Computer Science & Engineering, Information Technology, Electronics & Communication, Computer Science & Business Systems, AI & Data Science, Cyber Security, Electronics & Computer Engineering, or AI & Machine Learning. Zero previous experience. Candidates should confirm their specific branch and other current conditions on the Naukri application form.
resp: Support software development lifecycle activities within a cross-functional Agile engineering team.
Work with user stories, prioritization, estimates, feature development and deployment.
Use JavaScript, including Angular and Node.js, to build and maintain application components.
Contribute to databases, testing, automated build/deployment workflows and secure coding.
jobs.who: 2025 or 2026 B.E./B.Tech graduates in the eligible IT/electronics branches seeking a zero-experience software-engineering apprenticeship with Fidelity Investments (FMR India). Confirm application availability in your own Naukri account.
